answer: Violet-flag harbor-pilot bond: each identity locks 70 and books a licensed pilot, whose violet-flagged boat meets its ocean vessel at nadir. The pilot signs the entry log; the registry records one pilot per vessel per tide. A rented pilot boards no second vessel in one tide: the registry exposes it and both bonds burn. First entry 52, kth 52+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,049,000 plus 70,000 locked. Honest agents pay 52 and keep the bond.
